dialogues.speaker: Sitt
dialogues.text: Amurta is the oldest school in the Akademiya, and focuses on Biology.

dialogues.speaker: Sitt
dialogues.text: It was originally formed by the researchers who followed the Dendro Archon to cultivate the rainforest, and it is still the largest school today.

dialogues.speaker: Sitt
dialogues.text: It is represented by the color green and it includes disciplines such as biology, ecology, and medicine.

dialogues.speaker: Sitt
dialogues.text: Anyway, if it's not farming, it's stockbreeding.
